risk_if_not_implemented: Without Threat Intelligence Program, the organization's understanding of the threat environment may become stale, leaving defenses misaligned with active adversary tactics. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1). No threat is rated Likely for this control; threats rated Possible include Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Utility Service Disruption (MT-7), Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8).

compensating_control_1.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Threat Intelligence Program (THR-02) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Risk Management Program
compensating_control_2.description:
Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of strategic, operational and tactical risk management controls that are aligned with:
(1) The organization's Enterprise Risk Management (ERM); and
(2) Industry-recognized cybersecurity risk management practices.
compensating_control_2.justification: Risk Management Program (RSK-02) provides policy-level governance that compensates for the absence of Threat Intelligence Program (THR-02) by establishing documented expectations, accountability structures, and organizational guardrails. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
